captions_note: the mark stays above the chin: the reel's captions keep running under it
in_a_reel: WORD is one short word with an arrow to the speaker, a word that points at them; TRIGGER is the spoken word the snap lands on. The slot needs about 1.6 s from the snap
the slot must either end on a cut, or set F_BACK a few frames before its end so the colour comes back inside the slot
the buyer's style wins: the STYLE block sets the pencil colour and the handwriting (effects/INDEX.md, Restyling an effect's own words)
steps: edit WORD, TRIGGER and F_BACK in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # measures the head, prints the frames and the snapshot list
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
